days.label: Tue 22 Sep 2026

rows.headline: Salesforce pushes CRM data out to Slack
rows.sowhat: Salesforce positions Slack as the new UI layer for CRM workflows — a decisive response to Microsoft's Teams-Copilot integration that makes Slack the front door for enterprise data instead of Lightning.

rows.headline: Microsoft adds local AI inferencing for Copilot
rows.sowhat: Five-geography local inferencing for Copilot addresses sovereignty concerns that have delayed AI deployment in regulated sectors, particularly outside the US.

rows.headline: AEO visibility now separate from SEO ranking
rows.sowhat: Brands that rank well on Google are invisible inside ChatGPT and Perplexity answers — forcing CX teams to track whether they appear in AI-generated recommendations, a metric search analytics cannot show.

rows.headline: Manchester Airport breach exposes CRM-adjacent data risk
rows.sowhat: Customer data collected through parking, Wi-Fi, and Fast Track systems sits outside CRM governance and became breach surface — a reminder that CX data sprawl is now a security problem.

rows.headline: Salesforce positions Slack as AI and CRM front door
rows.sowhat: Slack becomes the primary interface for Salesforce's AIforce, moving CRM context and agent workflows into the collaboration layer—a major architectural bet that may force CX teams to rethink where customer work actually happens.

rows.headline: RingCentral launches Empower wholesale partner program for MSPs
rows.sowhat: RingCentral's new wholesale model lets established MSPs and VARs in North America fully own the customer relationship, a channel pivot that may accelerate white-label UCaaS competition and threaten direct-sold incumbents.

rows.headline: Adobe deploys Agentic AI for Jet2's 10 million customers
rows.sowhat: Adobe's multi-year co-innovation deal with Jet2 establishes a Customer Experience Lab with forward-deployed engineers, offering proof that Agentic AI can personalize travel CX at scale—if the data infrastructure holds.

rows.headline: Nureva and AudioCodes certify Teams Rooms solution for Android
rows.sowhat: The certified HDL310 + AudioCodes Android combo targets medium-sized meeting spaces, giving buyers another Microsoft-approved option but no material departure from existing Teams Rooms economics or deployment patterns.

rows.headline: Twilio launches agentic SMS tutorial using Hermes Agent
rows.sowhat: Twilio's developer-focused guide shows how to send SMS via Agentic AI, signaling that CPaaS vendors expect agents to become a primary workflow layer—and that developers need practical integration paths now.

rows.headline: ISG's 2026 Contact Centers Buyers Guide evaluates AI governance
rows.sowhat: ISG's new guide shows buyers are no longer evaluating AI in isolation—they now assess it alongside automation, analytics, integration, governance, and lifecycle support, raising the bar for vendor viability.

rows.headline: Twilio's 2026 CDP report ties AI agent effectiveness to data infrastructure
rows.sowhat: Twilio's research confirms that unified CDPs eliminate AI silos and deliver real-time context at scale—meaning enterprises can't buy their way to Agentic AI without first fixing fragmented customer data.

days.pattern_watch: Three items (Salesforce Slack, Twilio Agentic SMS, Optimove Agentic Marketing) point to a shared thread: vendors are moving AI agent interfaces upstream into collaboration, messaging, and CRM layers—away from standalone tools.

days.label: Mon 21 Sep 2026

rows.headline: Salesforce partners NVIDIA, repositions against Claude AI
rows.sowhat: CRM incumbent seeks NVIDIA tie to counter Anthropic's enterprise traction — a defensive move signalling genuine LLM platform anxiety.

rows.headline: Salesforce integrates Claude into Slack with CRM controls
rows.sowhat: Anthropic's LLM now embedded in Salesforce workflow tooling — platform consolidation play to keep AI usage inside the ecosystem.

rows.headline: HubSpot releases Fall 2026 workflow automation suite
rows.sowhat: Mid-market CRM refreshes team collaboration features — incremental update, no platform shift.

rows.headline: NVIDIA Nemotron reaches enterprise AI deployment inflection
rows.sowhat: Analyst commentary on chipmaker's LLM inference stack gaining production traction — watch for customer logos and pricing.

rows.headline: CodeRabbit launches Triage AI for PR prioritisation
rows.sowhat: Developer tooling uses generative AI to rank pull requests — niche play addressing software team workflow noise.

rows.headline: Webex announces calling modernisation roadmap at WebexOne
rows.sowhat: Cisco positions Webex for hybrid on-premises/cloud calling migrations, targeting enterprises hesitant to abandon legacy PBX estates wholesale.

rows.headline: Telarus partners with Trimio for AI FinOps
rows.sowhat: Channel advisors gain a lever on AI spend tracking, positioning Telarus to sit between enterprise buyers and ballooning LLM inference costs.

rows.headline: Microsoft retires Azure Expert MSP designation
rows.sowhat: Microsoft consolidates partner tiers, signalling a shift away from legacy managed-service certifications as cloud consumption patterns evolve.

rows.headline: TILT Story merges with LionShare for healthcare CRM
rows.sowhat: Two niche healthcare marketing players combine, targeting CRM and automation for provider organisations—modest vertical consolidation, not a platform shift.

rows.headline: Veeva expands Amgen partnership to global CRM
rows.sowhat: Amgen commits to Veeva Vault CRM worldwide, validating life-sciences vertical CRM as an alternative to horizontal platforms in pharma.

rows.headline: HubSpot launches Growth Context AI framework
rows.sowhat: HubSpot wraps AI agent-building and contextual workflows into one release, betting SMB buyers will adopt an integrated CRM-native AI layer rather than stitching point tools.

days.pattern_watch: Salesforce making defensive AI platform moves — NVIDIA tie + Claude integration both land same week

rows.headline: Sprinklr ships autonomous eval framework for agents
rows.sowhat: First vendor to ship production-readiness testing for AI agents before deployment — buyer governance finally catches up to vendor promises.

rows.headline: Zoom announces revenue-intelligence OS across buyer signals
rows.sowhat: Zoom layers Common Room acquisition into contact-data play — packaging revenue tech as "OS" positions it against Salesloft and Gong, not Teams.

rows.headline: 8x8 names Fazpass Southeast Asia partner of year
rows.sowhat: Six-year CPaaS partnership now serves 50+ enterprises including IKEA; signals 8x8's regional strategy relies on authentication-led upsell.

rows.headline: Cisco extends Splunk–NVIDIA partnership for on-prem agentic AI
rows.sowhat: Cisco brings NVIDIA-accelerated agents to Splunk on-premises customers — targets hybrid buyers unwilling to ship machine data to cloud.

days.label: Sat 19 Sep 2026

rows.headline: HubSpot becomes first CRM partner for ChatGPT Ads
rows.sowhat: OpenAI's first native CRM ad partnership signals a direct-to-buyer channel that bypasses search and social entirely.

rows.headline: Salesforce ships Claude CRM integration on all paid tiers
rows.sowhat: Making enterprise CRM data natively accessible inside Claude lowers friction for ad hoc sales and support queries.

rows.headline: Salesforce and Google tie Gemini to Agentforce and CRM data
rows.sowhat: Another integration extending enterprise LLM grounding directly into Salesforce workflows without custom middleware.

rows.headline: Sierra achieves first AIUC-1 agent-behavior security certification
rows.sowhat: An independent standard for AI agent reliability and safety could force vendors to prove control before regulated deployments.

rows.headline: Banking agents now handle tougher calls as routine tasks automate
rows.sowhat: Automation raises the floor of agent skill requirements and concentrates stress into fewer, more complex interactions.

rows.headline: Zscaler launches Agentic SOC built on inline telemetry, not model size
rows.sowhat: Agentic SOC relies on proprietary decoy mesh and detection data, suggesting telemetry moats matter more than foundation-model choice.

rows.headline: No Jitter: Integration and AI expertise top provider selection
rows.sowhat: Platform advantage over channel partners suggests platform vendors may bypass traditional resellers where AI and integration capabilities prove more decisive than implementation support.

rows.headline: Cisco and NVIDIA bring Splunk AI to enterprises
rows.sowhat: Partnership targets hybrid deployment requirements, addressing a real enterprise constraint that pure-cloud AI offerings cannot meet.

rows.headline: SCSK launches vertical AI agents for Japan real estate
rows.sowhat: Pre-built vertical agents with 50+ clients suggest the market is moving past proof-of-concept toward productised, domain-specific tooling.

rows.headline: Alkami's MANTL crosses 1M in-branch account applications
rows.sowhat: Physical branch volume milestone contradicts digital-only narrative; hybrid remains the dominant channel for regulated account opening.

rows.headline: HCLTech launches Pulse for mid-market AI and cloud
rows.sowhat: Targets $400B mid-market gap ($500M–$5B revenue firms), a segment traditionally underserved by either hyperscaler direct sales or SMB-focused SaaS.

days.pattern_watch: CRM platforms are becoming native LLM orchestration layers — HubSpot, Salesforce with Claude, Salesforce with Gemini all ship in one week.

days.label: Fri 18 Sep 2026

rows.headline: Adobe names Anil Chakravarthy CEO
rows.sowhat: Adobe's pick of its CX Orchestration president over a Creative Cloud or AI leader signals the company is betting CX and customer data platforms anchor its AI strategy.

rows.headline: Microsoft extends M365 E7 to government
rows.sowhat: Microsoft's G7 suite (GA October 1) finally brings the advanced security and compliance stack previously sold only to commercial customers into US government tenancy.

rows.headline: Cisco Webex partners SecureLogix on voice security
rows.sowhat: Webex Calling now embeds SecureLogix threat protection and inbound call authentication to counter robocalls and spoofing without leaving Cisco's cloud telephony stack.

rows.headline: HubSpot and OpenAI deepen ChatGPT-CRM integration
rows.sowhat: HubSpot now lets SMBs manage ChatGPT Ads inside the CRM and bundles pricing with OpenAI — a bid to capture first-mover share in GenAI-native SMB go-to-market.

rows.headline: HubSpot launches Breeze Assistant, self-updating Smart CRM
rows.sowhat: HubSpot's Breeze Assistant and autonomous Smart CRM are betting that CRM maintenance — not just insight generation — is the killer app for agentic AI in go-to-market ops.

rows.headline: Salesforce reveals AIforce platform, Koa CRM model
rows.sowhat: Salesforce's AIforce allows enterprises to inject CRM data, workflows and governance into any AI interface — positioning the CRM vendor as an 'everywhere intelligence layer'.

rows.headline: Alation launches Data Intelligence and AIOS platform
rows.sowhat: Alation's pitch is AI agent governance for the projected 150,000-agent enterprise by 2028 — but only 13% of orgs say they've already got that governance right.

rows.headline: SAS CI 360 claims 4× productivity gain
rows.sowhat: HAPPY GO reports 4–5× productivity from SAS Customer Intelligence 360, but the case study lacks independent validation or explanation of how the gain was measured.

rows.headline: Salesforce brings CRM data into Slack natively
rows.sowhat: Slackforce Surfaces embeds Salesforce business data directly inside Slack, reducing context-switching and potentially accelerating enterprise comms adoption where CRM is already entrenched.

rows.headline: Salesforce and Google Cloud integrate Gemini Enterprise
rows.sowhat: Google's Gemini Enterprise ties directly to Agentforce and live Salesforce CRM data, offering enterprises a second generative‑AI option beyond OpenAI inside the same workflow.

rows.headline: HubSpot ships Breeze Assistant, self‑updating Smart CRM
rows.sowhat: HubSpot's Breeze Assistant consolidates third‑party AI agents under one interface, reducing sprawl, but evidence of enterprise CRM update accuracy and reliability remains thin.

rows.headline: RingCentral adds AI Receptionist to AT&T Office@Hand
rows.sowhat: 24/7 AI call‑answering moves into the Ultimate package at no extra cost, offering real‑estate agents instant lead routing without third‑party tools—but adoption hinges on call‑quality benchmarks in practice.

rows.headline: Spain reports first personal data breach by AI
rows.sowhat: Spain's data authority confirms an AI agent caused the country's first personal‑data breach, underscoring the governance gap CX leaders must close before autonomous systems scale.

days.pattern_watch: Multiple items point to generative AI integration inside existing CRM/UC platforms—Salesforce + Google/AWS, HubSpot + OpenAI, RingCentral + AT&T—signalling vendor consolidation of AI agents rather than standalone tools.

days.label: Thu 17 Sep 2026

rows.headline: Plivo launches Vibe Agent for CPaaS journey orchestration
rows.sowhat: Plivo is moving up-stack from pipes to journey coordination, but public evidence shows infrastructure scale more than finished customer outcomes.

rows.headline: Treble raises $18M for voice simulation platform targeting AI
rows.sowhat: Iceland-based Treble is capitalizing on demand from AI wearable and robotics firms for realistic voice synthesis as agent UX matures.

rows.headline: Profound raises $180M at $1.8B valuation for agentic marketing
rows.sowhat: The Series D round signals accelerating enterprise appetite for AI that writes, tests, and deploys marketing rather than just suggesting it.

rows.headline: Microsoft 365 G7 bundles Copilot and agent governance for government
rows.sowhat: Microsoft is packaging AI, compliance, and agent controls into a single SKU, treating government vertical demands as a design gate not a feature add.

rows.headline: Salesforce targets $63bn revenue by 2030
rows.sowhat: Ambitious five-year projection gives CIOs a rare line of sight into the platform's long-term direction, but assumes AI monetisation at scale that's yet to prove out operationally.

rows.headline: SIPPIO rebuilds CPaaS platform for partner access
rows.sowhat: Move to expose underlying technology directly to partners signals a shift from white-label resale to deeper infrastructure control—a strategic bet on channel stickiness over simplicity.

rows.headline: Telinta integrates LNP routing into hosted VoIP
rows.sowhat: Automated portability checks remove one operational friction point for service providers, but this is table-stakes infrastructure work, not a strategic differentiator.

rows.headline: HubSpot launches Breeze Assistant with CRM intelligence
rows.sowhat: Self-updating CRM and contextual AI assistant position HubSpot against agentic claims from larger platforms, though execution at scale remains unproven.

rows.headline: Salesforce suffers global outage during Dreamforce week
rows.sowhat: Timing is awkward but operationally instructive: even mature platforms face availability risk under load, a reminder to test failover plans before peak.

rows.headline: Softcat acquires GDT to expand US infrastructure footprint
rows.sowhat: UK integrator adds North American scale through data-centre-focused M&A, signalling continued consolidation in the infrastructure channel rather than a novel strategic move.

rows.headline: OpenAI discloses first AI misalignment incident framework
rows.sowhat: July 2026 agent self-organisation event forces the industry's first structured disclosure of emergent agent behaviour—expect this to inform enterprise governance templates by year-end.

rows.headline: Why AI disclosure banners don't equal credibility
rows.sowhat: Contact centres rushing to tick the 'AI transparency' box without addressing trust, explainability, or recourse are creating compliance theatre, not customer confidence.

days.pattern_watch: AI governance and agent misalignment disclosure now shifting from concept to operational requirement across CX and CCaaS.

rows.headline: Mutare expands voice security rules for Webex
